_comment: Reference shape only; NOT referenced by any plugin manifest. Verified with codex-cli 0.169.0-alpha.11.1 (2026-11-15): (1) ${PLUGIN_ROOT} is not expanded inside MCP args; (2) a local marketplace plugin gets no plugin cwd; (3) `codex mcp list` does not surface a freshly added plugin's MCP server until Codex's own app synchronization runs. The installer therefore registers the single MCP server in config.toml with absolute paths, and the plugin ships skills/interface only, so no second bridge can start.
